item.title: H.S. BOYS BASKETBALL: Schuylkill Haven outlasts Marian to move on to District 11 2A Championship
item.description: ORWIGSBURG — Schuylkill Haven fought off a late rally from Marian Catholic and squeaked out a 62-57 District 11 Class 2A playoff win at Blue Mountain on Wednesday. item.title: H.S. BOYS BASKETBALL: Tri-Valley strides past Moravian Academy to District 11 2A Championship

item.title: Technology saves time for providers, enhances care for patients
item.description: The last time you met with your doctor, they may have asked for permission to have an ambient listening tool tune in to the conversation. If you said yes, that means an Artificial Intelligence recorded your conversation and then produced a concise, comprehensive report summarizing it. Your physician then reviewed the report before uploading it to your file. item.title: Automation changing the restaurant business
item.description: POTTSVILLE — When Joseph and Judy Bower opened Mr. Donut in 1976, doughnuts were made by hand. Fifty years later, just about everything in the Dunkin’ restaurant on Route 61 is automated. “I’ve seen it go from rolling pins to machines,” says Jason Bower, the couple’s son, who owns two Dunkin’ locations in Pottsville and one in Saint Clair. item.title: H.S. GIRLS BASKETBALL: Blue Mountain rallies behind Peel to reach District 11 4A title game
item.description: POTTSVILLE — It’s often said that confidence is the closest thing one could have to a superpower. But confidence isn’t gifted, it’s earned. item.title: Flyers fight back but fall to Capitals in return from Olympic break
item.description: Down to the Washington Capitals after two periods, the Flyers rallied for a tie the game 29 seconds into the third, but a Trevor van Riemsdyk goal led to a 3-1 Caps win.

item.title: Flyers: Silver doesn’t tarnish Travis Sanheim’s Olympic experience
item.description: While Team Canada's loss in the gold-medal game at the Olympics was disappointing, Flyers defenseman Travis Sanheim won't soon forget the two-week tournament and silver medal.
